newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to offer 16 to 18 bln Ffr OATs Thursday.
newsitem.headline: France to offer 16 to 18 bln Ffr OATs Thursday.

text.p: France is to offer between 16 and 18 billion francs of government bonds (OATs) at its next scheduled auction on September 5, the Treasury said.
The 6.50 percent October 2006, the 8.25 percent February 2004 and TEC-10 lines will be on offer.
The payment date for all three lines is September 25, 1996. The maturity date for the 2006 and TEC-10 bond is October 25, 2006 and the maturity date for the 2004 bond is February 27, 2004.
